 Everything you need to know ahead of election day 
 By Natalia Unseld Published : Oct. 23, 2026 at 5:10 PM CDT | Updated : 1 hour ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google What This Story Is About 
 Kentucky voters will decide local, state and federal races on Nov. 3, with free Voter ID cards available now at driver licensing offices. 
 Why It Matters 
 Local and state offices directly shape roads, schools, spending, and services, so knowing what each office controls helps voters look past slogans. 
 What Happens Next 
 Voters should confirm registration, polling place, ID, and early-voting options at GoVoteKy.com before Election Day. 
 For Context 
 Offices offer Saturday hours Oct. 24 from 8 to 11:30 a.m. for voters who still need an ID. 
 BOWLING GREEN, Ky. — Election Day is approaching on Nov. 3, and voters across Kentucky are preparing to decide who will represent them at the local, state, and federal levels.
 Beyond the names and parties on the ballot, understanding what each office does can help voters make more informed decisions.
 While national races get the most attention, local and state offices often have the most direct impact on road improvements, community development, public spending and local services.
 How to prepare before Election Day
 To avoid last-minute confusion:
 Confirm your registration status and find your polling location through Kentucky’s official election resources at GoVoteKy.com. 
 Preview your ballot to review the candidates and offices you’ll see. 
 Verify ID requirements, polling hours, and early-voting options for your county. 
 Election rules can vary by location, so use official state or county sources — not social media posts.
 Free Voter ID cards available
 The Beshear administration is offering free Voter ID cards to eligible registered voters who do not have an accepted form of ID.
 Cards can be requested at any of the Kentucky Transportation Cabinet’s 35 Driver Licensing Regional Offices or at scheduled pop-up driver licensing events.
 Offices are open Monday through Friday from 8 a.m. to 4 p.m. Saturday service will be offered at all offices on Oct. 24 from 8 to 11:30 a.m.
